caesars: Score both screenshot sides at their exact lines against the saved leave-Caesars-out consensus. Highest EV is a diagnostic comparison, not a betting lean if all EV <=0. Unknown screenshot time precludes actionable PLAY even if arithmetic filter passed. Book is user-context assumption. No stakes.
freshness: All original quote/forecast times retained; weather repair occurred after Friday prices. Audit evidence copy only, never a new production live version.
historical: Inspect and reproduce existing prior-season market-residual baseline only. Exact live selection evaluation requires archived timestamped multi-book prices; never replace missing data with nflverse closes. No E3 rerun. Existing historical results have already been viewed. This is descriptive verification, not a new registered superiority test.
scope: Read-only evidence audit; no production changes, no gate changes, no provider odds calls
sensitivity: Report +/-0.5 consensus-center sensitivity using unchanged inference; this is numerical robustness testing, not alternative selections or fitted models.
uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals resampling entire seasons with replacement, 10000 replicates seed 20260912; retains within-season dependence. Ten seasons; descriptive, no superiority gate. Calibration means weighted by n.
